rendered: The sodiation of the carbon layer provides a capacity of 0.05 mAh/cm^2[1], which the paper says is negligible next to the plating capacities. The highest plating capacity demonstrated is up to 12 mAh/cm^2[2]. The sodiation capacity is therefore a fraction of about 0.42%[3] of that maximum plating capacity.
